newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks perk as law okayed, but close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks perk as law okayed, but close mixed.

text.p: Caracas stocks took brief midday heart following congressional approval of the Privatization Law Reform Bill, which paves the way for CANTV's privatization, but then closed off as interest rates edged up a hair, traders said.
The bolsa's 19-share index slipped 0.11 percent to close at 6,007.12 points after a mixed session saw 16 shares rise, 16 fall and eight close flat.
Just over 30 million shares traded worth three billion bolivars ($6.4 million) as yields on benchmark Central Bank TEMs edged ahead two basis points to 22.00 percent.
